text:
kay: Heads-up: small spike in fncall validator rejects in ap-northeast starting 16:40 UTC. Reject tag = TOOL_RESPONSE_SHAPE.
omar: I see it too. Canary for stricter validator landed at 16:30 (5%).
jo: Sample (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "pricing_lookup",
  "out": {
    "price": 9.99,
    "meta": []
  },
  "req_id": "r_xy9"
}
```
Validator expects meta as object; legacy shims return [] for empty.
kay: Ops, can we soft-validate affected tenant shards while infra patches shims?
ops: Yep, enabling soft-validate for shards t-410/t-411 now. Creating incident #7201.
omar: I'm going to push a tiny coercion in adapter-shim to normalize null|[]|"" -> {} before validator call. ETA ~15m.
jo: Console asks: can we add a "preflight simulation" button on the rollout page that runs the coercion on a sample of recent requests and reports how many payloads would change shape? That helps decide whether to flip auto-routing.
telemetry-bot: note: canary roll "strict-validator" set to 5% in ap-northeast at 16:30 UTC by omar
ops: Preflight sim is a great idea. Also require an audit-interlock: auto-route/fallback should be disabled unless audit logging is ON for that rollout. We need the actor and reason logged for any automated fallback.
j o: Minor nit: call it "validator failover" in the UI rather than "auto-fallback" to make intent clearer to non-platform folks.
omar: Good. Implementation notes: 1) add trace/span tags: validator.mode, validator.slice_pct, and routing.failover=true|false. 2) emit metric fncall.validator.rejects_total{region,tenant,mode} and fncall.validator.failovers_total{region,tenant}.
kay: Billing question: if requests are failovered to permissive route, billing must reflect that (model variant label or "failover" flag). Otherwise cost dashboards will be wrong.
ops: Agreed. We will require routing.attribution tag to be set when we change route due to validator failover. Billing team will reconcile.
jo: Console UX: add a small cost-preview when enabling validator failover: show estimated p50 latency delta and projected monthly cost delta for the slice based on last 1h sample. Add two-step confirmation for region-wide toggles.
omar: For raw debugging, propose a permissioned "unmasked_sample" link on reject rows that pulls the full payload into a secure store (RBAC: platform+sre+oncall). Retain samples at 0.5% for 7 days.
telemetry-bot: suggestion: add a shimmer sparkline on the rollout page: rejects_pct vs canary_pct over last 60m and a preflight summary showing how many samples would have been coerced.
okay: Decision list: 1) omar to push coercion patch; 2) ops enabled soft-validate for t-410/t-411; 3) console: add preflight-sim, validator-failover toggle with interlock+audit trail, cost-preview, and two-step confirmation; 4) telemetry: add tags/metrics and sample retention policy; 5) billing: ensure routing.attribution tag is honored for cost accounting.
omar: Patch PR opened, CI passing, releasing in ~10m. Will ping when adapters are live.
ops: Incident #7201 created and monitoring. Will revert soft-validate after 5m stable check (rejects <0.5%).
kay: Thanks. Once patch lands run preflight sim and post results here before flipping anything.
console-bot: opsbot: incident #7201 created "fncall validator rejects spike - ap-northeast" assigned to eng-platform
